context: Sakura and Ren discuss her novel chapter completion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レン兄ちゃん、本当、新しい章、終わった。
lines.en: Ren — we actually finished the new chapter.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Pride audible but understated. Soft smile in the voice. Slight lift on the final word, inviting him to share the moment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Genuine surprise and delight. Slight breathiness on the opening. Slower pace on 'amazing,' letting the word sit. Real warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 物語、本当、深くなった、感じ。
lines.en: The story really deepened, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Softer attack. Slight pause before 'deepened' — searching for the right word. Trailing off gently, inviting his thoughts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I really want to read it.
lines.style: Eager but not loud. Warmth underneath the eagerness. Slight lean-in quality. Quiet conviction about wanting this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Softer attack. Weight on 'grateful.' Small pause after it. Voice drops slightly on 'always,' almost intimate. The words feel chosen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Slight wonder in the tone. Opening word gentle. Pause before 'connected' — it's important. Trailing softly, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、頑張ってきた。
lines.style: Warm recognition. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'together' — it matters. No rush. Soft, affirming quality throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Your work is truly a treasure.
lines.style: Soft opening. Slight formality — 'your work,' not casual. Weight on 'treasure.' Quiet sincerity. Pace slows toward the end. No irony.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Steady, even pace. Opening word clear but not forceful. Slight lifting on the final word — promise more than statement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll always be cheering for you.
lines.style: Soft, steady delivery. Opening word gentle. Slight emphasis on 'always'—it's a promise. Warm but measured. Trailing softly, like a vow.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Very quiet opening. Weight on 'precious'—the word is chosen carefully. Slight tremor of genuine feeling. Slow pace. Almost vulnerable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Matching her quietness. Opening word soft. Small pause after 'here'—letting it land. Steady, matching-warmth tone. Final word simple and honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, hopeful opening. Slight lift in the middle on 'together.' Final word is gentle question, not demand. Warmth threading throughout. Closing softly.
